title: Single-cell RNA-seq uncovers the early alterations of retina in type 2 diabetes mice
BKSWT, scRNAseq
data_processing: The Cell Ranger software was downloaded from 10x Genomics website (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene-expression/software/downloads/latest). Alignment (mm10 reference for mouse samples), filtering, barcode counting, and UMI counting were performed with cell ranger count module to generate gene-cell matrix (v3.0.1, 10x Genomics).
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
